description:
A customer brings in a defective computer and the CRS checks the defect and hands out a repair cost calculation back.
If the customer decides that the costs are acceptable, the process continues, otherwise she takes her computer home unrepaired.
The ongoing repair consists of two activities, which are executed, in an arbitrary order.
The first activity is to check and repair the hardware, whereas the second activity checks and configures the software.
After each of these activities, the proper system functionality is tested.
If an error is detected another arbitrary repair activity is executed, otherwise the repair is finished.

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Computer" name="Defective computer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairDecision" name="Customer repair decision"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Computer" name="Bring in defective computer" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Start_CRS" messageRef="Message_Computer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" sourceRef="Task_SendCalculation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCalculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AcceptDecision" name="Send repair decision" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision"/>

    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_BringComputer" name="Bring in defective computer" messageRef="Message_Computer">

    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCalculation" name="Receive repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation">

    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcceptCosts" name="Are the costs acceptable?" default="Flow_Customer_Reject">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Accept</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Reject</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptDecision" name="Send acceptance of repair costs" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Accept</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeComputerHome" name="Take computer home unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Reject</bpmn:incoming>

    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer_Accepted" name="Repair accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer_Rejected" name="Computer taken home unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_BringComputer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptCosts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Accept" name="Acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptCosts" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptDecision">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[costsAcceptable]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Reject" name="Not acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptCosts" targetRef="Task_TakeComputerHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptDecision" targetRef="End_Customer_Accepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_TakeComputerHome" targetRef="Task_SendRejectDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_SendRejectDecision" targetRef="End_Customer_Rejected"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS repair process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CRS" name="Defective computer received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageStartDefinition_Computer" messageRef="Message_Computer"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive customer repair decision" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CRS_Decision" name="Are the costs acceptable?" default="Flow_CRS_Reject">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_Accept</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_Reject</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CRS_Unrepaired" name="Repair not undertaken">

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairSplit" name="Perform both repair activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Accept</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Repair_Hardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Repair_Software</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Hardware" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Repair_Hardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Hardware_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test_AfterHardware" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Hardware_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Hardware_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Software" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Repair_Software</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Software_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test_AfterSoftware" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Software_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Software_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairJoin" name="Both repair activities tested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Hardware_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Software_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InitialError" name="Is an error detected?" default="Flow_NoInitialError">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InitialError</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoInitialError</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" name="Choose another repair activity">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InitialError</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalError</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalHardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalSoftware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdditionalHardware" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalHardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalHardwareTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdditionalSoftware" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalSoftware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalSoftwareTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge" name="Repair activity complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalHardwareTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalSoftwareTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAfterAdditionalRepair" name="Test system functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalTestResult</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalError" name="Is an error detected?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalError">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalTestResult</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalError</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdditionalError</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoInitialError</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdditionalError</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_1" sourceRef="Start_CRS" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_SendCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_3" sourceRef="Task_SendCalculation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CRS_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Accept" name="Acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_CRS_Decision" targetRef="Gateway_RepairSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[costsAcceptable]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Reject" name="Not acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_CRS_Decision" targetRef="End_CRS_Unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_Hardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware_Test" sourceRef="Task_Hardware" targetRef="Task_Test_AfterHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware_Join" sourceRef="Task_Test_AfterHardware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_Software" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_Software"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software_Test" sourceRef="Task_Software" targetRef="Task_Test_AfterSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software_Join" sourceRef="Task_Test_AfterSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_5" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairJoin" targetRef="Gateway_InitialError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialError" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[errorDetected]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInitialError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialError" targetRef="End_RepairFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalHardware" name="Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" targetRef="Task_AdditionalHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalSoftware" name="Software" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" targetRef="Task_AdditionalSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalHardwareTest" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalHardware" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalSoftwareTest" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalTest" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge" targetRef="Task_TestAfterAdditionalRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalTestResult" sourceRef="Task_TestAfterAdditionalRepair" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalError" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[errorDetected]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalError" targetRef="End_RepairFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
